summary: A six-track synth and groovebox firmware with eight synthesis engines and twelve shared voices, descended from Pocket GammaWave and Felucca. It comes with a browser emulator and a Web Studio editor.
features: Eight engines incl. 6-op FM, phase distortion, tonewheel organ and drum synthesis
200 factory sounds; CPU modes run 4, 5 or 6 tracks
64 steps per track with ratchets, conditions and parameter locks
Song chains, arpeggiator, scales and chords, punch-in effects, mutate
Five reverbs, delay, slicer, master EQ and limiter
USB MIDI with SysEx; author states it is not yet measured on hardware

headings: target firmware jieli pi32v2 clang + the ac79 sdk
the 10-voice profile, and a pool size other than the default
the host tests: golden renders, voice / routing checks, ui, cpu budget
what this project does not claim
